```python
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(df, target_values=[1, 3, 4]):
    """
    Replace all values not in target_values with 0 for each column,
    then plot the distribution of each transformed column.

    Returns
    -------
    matplotlib.axes.Axes
        An Axes object from the plotted data.
    """
    transformed = df.copy()

    target_set = set(target_values)
    for col in transformed.columns:
        transformed[col] = transformed[col].where(transformed[col].isin(target_set), 0)

    cols = list(transformed.columns)
    if not cols:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.set_axis_off()
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No columns to display", ha="center", va="center")
        return ax

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows=len(cols), ncols=1, figsize=(8, max(3, 3 * len(cols))))
    if len(cols) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for ax, col in zip(axes, cols):
        sns.countplot(x=transformed[col], ax=ax)
        ax.set_title(col)
        ax.set_xlabel(col)
        ax.set_ylabel("Count")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return axes[0]
```
